blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.19
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.19

blocks.text: शक्तिसन्धाने शरीरोत्पत्तिः
blocks.directed: [slowly] शक्तिसन्धाने शरीरोत्पत्तिः

blocks.text: Śaktisandhāne śarīrotpattiḥ.
blocks.directed: Śaktisandhāne śarīrotpattiḥ.

blocks.text: Through union with Śakti, there is the production of bodies.
blocks.directed: Through union with Śakti, there is the production of bodies.

blocks.text: Oh Brilliant, Apparently You Can Create Bodies Now.
blocks.directed: Oh Brilliant, Apparently You Can Create Bodies Now.

blocks.text: Right.
blocks.directed: [short pause] Right.

blocks.text: Well.
blocks.directed: Well.

blocks.text: We’ve had a lovely philosophical discussion about consciousness.
blocks.directed: We’ve had a lovely philosophical discussion about consciousness.

blocks.text: We’ve examined bondage, recognition, meditation, the three states, the divine powers, and the unity of the universe.
blocks.directed: We’ve examined bondage, recognition, meditation, the three states, the divine powers, and the unity of the universe.

blocks.text: And Vasugupta has now decided that we’re going to start creating bodies.
blocks.directed: And Vasugupta has now decided that we’re going to start creating bodies.

blocks.text: Of course we are.
blocks.directed: Of course we are.

blocks.text: This is Tantra.
blocks.directed: This is Tantra.

blocks.text: At some point, the metaphysics was always going to become absolutely outrageous.
blocks.directed: At some point, the metaphysics was always going to become absolutely outrageous.

blocks.text: First, the traditional explanation.
blocks.directed: First, the traditional explanation.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja links this directly to the icchāśakti described in 1.13.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja links this directly to the icchāśakti described in 1.13.

blocks.text: Through profound union with divine will, the realised yogi is said to gain the capacity to manifest a body according to desire.
blocks.directed: Through profound union with divine will, the realised yogi is said to gain the capacity to manifest a body according to desire.

blocks.text: This is part of what traditional texts call vibhūti or siddhi — extraordinary spiritual powers.
blocks.directed: This is part of what traditional texts call vibhūti or siddhi — extraordinary spiritual powers.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja really does interpret the statement as a supernatural accomplishment. He is not merely describing ordinary creativity, imagination, or a poetic change in self-image. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja really does interpret the statement as a supernatural accomplishment. He is not merely describing ordinary creativity, imagination, or a poetic change in self-image. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: So we shouldn’t pretend the text says something modest just because the literal claim makes modern readers uncomfortable.
blocks.directed: So we shouldn’t pretend the text says something modest just because the literal claim makes modern readers uncomfortable.

blocks.text: At the same time, this is a traditional metaphysical and yogic claim, not an experimentally demonstrated human capacity.
blocks.directed: At the same time, this is a traditional metaphysical and yogic claim, not an experimentally demonstrated human capacity.

blocks.text: Now why would such a claim appear here?
blocks.directed: Now why would such a claim appear here?

blocks.text: Because the entire first section has been describing a transformation from contracted agency to identification with universal consciousness.
blocks.directed: Because the entire first section has been describing a transformation from contracted agency to identification with universal consciousness.

blocks.text: In ordinary life, our capacity to act is restricted.
blocks.directed: In ordinary life, our capacity to act is restricted.

blocks.text: We can imagine countless things that we cannot actually produce.
blocks.directed: We can imagine countless things that we cannot actually produce.

blocks.text: But divine svātantrya, in the Trika system, is not restricted by those ordinary limitations.
blocks.directed: But divine svātantrya, in the Trika system, is not restricted by those ordinary limitations.

blocks.text: The siddhi claims are expressions of that metaphysical distinction.
blocks.directed: The siddhi claims are expressions of that metaphysical distinction.

blocks.text: You can follow the philosophical logic without assuming that a contemporary practitioner can literally conjure an additional human organism into existence.
blocks.directed: You can follow the philosophical logic without assuming that a contemporary practitioner can literally conjure an additional human organism into existence.

blocks.text: And perhaps the funniest thing is that this apparently astonishing power receives only one sūtra.
blocks.directed: And perhaps the funniest thing is that this apparently astonishing power receives only one sūtra.

blocks.text: Vasugupta mentions the creation of bodies.
blocks.directed: Vasugupta mentions the creation of bodies.

blocks.text: Then immediately moves on.
blocks.directed: Then immediately moves on.

blocks.text: As though he’s just told you to remember to buy milk.
blocks.directed: As though he’s just told you to remember to buy milk.
